title: MOER: Mix-Policy Optimization under Expert Prefix Guidance with Selective Rollback
abstract: arXiv:2610.30873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mix-policy optimization incorporates off-policy expert data into the reinforcement learning (RL) loop to transcend the capability boundary of on-policy RL. However, existing methods either provide static full-trace guidance that suppresses self-exploration, or adopt expert prefix guidance without correctness guarantees, leading to suboptimal performance or even training collapse. In this paper, we propose MOER, a mix-policy optimization framework that harmonizes expert guidance with self-exploration. MOER injects a decaying expert chain-of-thought prefix into the prompt and lets the model complete the remaining reasoning, with the prefix length progressively annealed to encourage self-exploration. A selective rollback mechanism replaces failed completions with the original full expert trace, guaranteeing the correctness of every off-policy trajectory. translated_title: MOER：专家前缀引导下结合选择性回滚的混合策略优化
translated_abstract: 混合策略优化将离策略专家数据引入强化学习（RL）循环中，以突破在策略强化学习的能力边界。然而，现有方法要么提供静态的完整轨迹引导，抑制了模型的自我探索；要么采用缺乏正确性保证的专家前缀引导，导致性能欠佳甚至训练崩溃。本文提出MOER，一个能够协调专家引导与自我探索的混合策略优化框架。MOER将一个衰减的专家思维链前缀注入提示中，让模型完成剩余的推理，并通过逐步退火前缀长度来鼓励自我探索。选择性回滚机制用原始的完整专家轨迹替换失败的补全，保证每条离策略轨迹的正确性。此外，一个协调的混合策略目标使用GRPO对在策略token进行优化（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: MOER提出一种混合策略优化框架，通过逐步衰减的专家思维链前缀引导并配合选择性回滚机制保证离策略轨迹正确性，协调了专家引导与模型自我探索。
en_tdlr: MOER is a mix-policy optimization framework that harmonizes expert guidance with self-exploration through progressively annealed expert chain-of-thought prefixes and a selective rollback mechanism guaranteeing the correctness of every off-policy trajectory.
